extraction.Name: William Gibbons
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County (Pine Ridge area, South Dakota)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment, for he did not want to pay taxes; but the Indian Agency told him that it would be taxed anyway, and finally sold for taxes, if he did not accept the patent, so he took it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Isaac H. Chase, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $300.00; sold to his sister, Annie Hornbeck, she paying off the mortgage, and paying him $500.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he never paid his taxes; he was unable to pay off this mortgage, and sold the place as he could not pay off the mortgage
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms his wife's heirship land for a living, this being his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has pretty fair health; has a wife and five children to support, the family having good health; mortgaged in 1920, sold in 1921; described the sale price as 'a very poor price for the place, but the best he could do under the circumstances'; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document signed December 10, 1928
